page.content:
Pony nation of Canterlot, Ponyville, and the Crystal Empire.

How Equestria connects

  • Series: My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic — Friendship Is Magic is set in Equestria.
  • Character: Princess Celestia — Princess Celestia rules Equestria and raises the sun.
  • Location: Ponyville — Ponyville is a market town in Equestria.
  • Location: Canterlot — Canterlot is the mountain capital of Equestria.
  • Location: Crystal Empire — The Crystal Empire sits on Equestria's northern map.
  • Character: Princess Luna — Princess Luna shares Equestria's throne and raises the moon.

What is Equestria?

Equestria is the kingdom Princess Celestia and Princess Luna rule: Ponyville in the countryside, Canterlot on the mountain, and later the Crystal Empire to the north, the map Friendship Is Magic never leaves for long.

Key threads lead to My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic, Princess Celestia, Ponyville, Canterlot, Crystal Empire and Princess Luna.
